node.title: Re: Returning an array in a specific way for csv
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Could you be more specific what you want the output to look like? Also, how would the code know when to break apart the input - is it just each "X1" marker that the code encounters, or is it something else like "BEGIN_TAG"? To put that a different way, what should the output for this input look like? ([id://174051])

BEGIN_TAG X1 a b c d X1 e f g h BEGIN_TAG X1 i j k l X1 m n o p

As for the data structure, as one possibility I'd suggest you have a look at "Hashes of Arrays" in [doc://perldsc].

Update: For CSV input and output, I'd very strongly recommend [mod://Text::CSV].
